prompt: ISO 26262: what are the technical requirements for the functional requirement "HMI shall be able to detect errors or unplausible data in the data stream and diplay a warning on driver display"?
response: For the functional requirement "HMI shall be able to detect errors or unplausible data in the data stream and display a warning on the driver display," the technical requirements include ensuring the HMI has robust data validation mechanisms. It should be capable of detecting inconsistencies or errors in the data stream and promptly alert the driver through the display. Implementing fail-safe mechanisms and regular data integrity checks are essential to prevent misleading warnings.
